failure.title: Trivy image scan passed a subcommand flag at global CLI scope
failure.note: The fourth focused Docker protocol retained the exact pinned-Trivy CLI failure, valid preceding SPDX proof, and clean teardown after QA-DKR-001 through QA-DKR-011 passed.
failure.diagnosis: The harness placed --skip-version-check before the Trivy image subcommand even though pinned Trivy 0.67.2 exposes that option only in image scope. Argument parsing therefore exited 1 before the scanner could emit SARIF or a vulnerability verdict.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
